Websites: “What kind of site?” at creation (WordPress, Laravel, Joomla, Bitrix, SPA and others) sets the mode, template and root folder for you.
Websites: the nginx page cache with one choice of period and a Clear cache button; works with PHP-FPM, Apache, OpenLiteSpeed and applications.
Websites: PHP load profiles (economical, normal, high), PHP memory and run time for a site.
Websites: protection with checkboxes — security headers, protection of images from hotlinking, a site password, admin area only from chosen IPs.
Site templates: a template library (Drupal, OpenCart, MediaWiki, phpBB, MODX and others) updated from GitHub, and a check of the template against the site mode.
